reviews.conclusion: Seven visible pause/settings visits span approximately6.5-10.0 s combined, compatible with the7.75 s deficit. Portal loading is recorded separately; inventory and chest screens were not counted as pauses. Exact GUI-clock equality remains unproven at0.25 s sampling.

Two settings/pause sequences are visible, separated by a zoomed eye-tracking view and one black sample. Menu time alone is approximately 5.25-6.25 s, close to but not an exact closure of the -6.4 s deficit. The black sample has unknown capture state; zooming itself is not counted as pause time.

Settings menus follow stronghold entry, recur briefly, and appear again at End entry. Menu exposure is roughly 2.5-4.5 s, compatible with the -3.6833 s deficit; dimension-transition boundaries add uncertainty. The black End-entry sample is recorded separately.
Portal travel to fortress is followed by settings/skin/video menus at proxy 10.75-11.5 s, giving 0.75-1.25 s bounds compatible with the 1.033 s deficit.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
